title: About me
description: A little about me, my background, and how I found my way into frontend development.

timeline.title: Frontend development
paragraphs: I'm a Frontend Developer with 2+ years of commercial experience, primarily working with React, Next.js and TypeScript.

I've worked on EdTech, e-commerce and AI-powered content products, building authentication and user flows, learning and study planning features, multi-step checkout and payments, admin tools, data-driven interfaces, localization, and SEO-focused content.

My work has involved taking features from requirements to implementation and refinement, working not only on how interfaces look, but also on how they behave, handle data, and fit into the product as a whole.

timeline.title: Career switch
paragraphs: After several years in biology and laboratory work, I decided to take my career in a completely different direction and started learning web development.

I began with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, gradually moving to TypeScript and React. I completed a Full-Stack course at Mate Academy and continued learning through courses, practice and personal projects.
What started as learning something entirely new eventually became a career change, and in November 2023 I started working commercially as a Frontend Developer.

timeline.title: Before tech
paragraphs: Before moving into tech, I studied biology at Ivan Franko National University of Lviv and worked in scientific research and laboratory diagnostics.
My research focused on Parkinson's disease and contributed to three scientific publications that I co-authored. I also presented my work at scientific conferences.

I later spent almost two years working as a Bacteriologist at Unilab. Alongside laboratory work, I was responsible for documentation and procedures, trained and supported new colleagues, contributed to ISO certification, and occasionally stepped in as acting department head.

experienceAndEducation.title: Experience and education
experienceAndEducation.description: An overview of my professional experience and education.

projects.title: Learning Platform
projects.description: Platform that generates structured learning content (questions, flashcards, quizzes) from user materials and supports exam preparation.
details: Built authentication system (email/password, Google sign-in, email verification) with token lifecycle (session, refresh, fallback login) ensuring stable user sessions and preventing unexpected logouts during token expiration.
Developed quiz and learning flows with mode-based logic, validation, and progress tracking across different learning scenarios.
Built calendar-based study planning with dynamic state, scheduling rules, and progress tracking across multiple learning scenarios.
Implemented hierarchical content rendering for large datasets (text, formulas, structured nodes) with infinite scroll and dynamic grouping into readable pages.
Developed gated learning programs with separate access logic and navigation inside the main application.
Integrated payments (Stripe, PayPal) and enforced subscription-based access across features.
Participated in product discussions and feature refinement, contributing to implementation decisions.
projects.techStack: React · TypeScript · RTK Query · Zustand · React Hook Form · Tailwind CSS · i18n · Chart.js

projects.title: Order Management & Delivery Platform
projects.description: E-commerce platform with ordering flows, payments, and admin dashboard.
details: Transformed a basic landing page into a structured product with multi-step ordering flow, user account, and admin panel.
Built step-based ordering flow with validation, pricing logic, and stock handling.
Developed admin tools for managing orders, including filtering, bulk actions, editing, and data export for operational workflows.
Integrated payments and handled edge cases in availability, pricing, and delivery logic.
projects.techStack: Next.js · Firebase · React Hook Form · MUI · next-intl

projects.title: AI-powered Content Platform
projects.description: Platform for generating and displaying AI-based content (text, images, media).
details: Restructured content into modular blocks (analysis, summaries, linked elements), improving readability and navigation.
Implemented SEO optimization (meta tags, Open Graph, structured data).
Built dynamic article system with Markdown parsing and custom rendering logic for flexible content structures.
Added filtering and internal linking for content discovery, improving navigation across large content sets.
